tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Recessed fills that sit on a pane: code blocks, step output, chips, tab strip, board columns.

tokens.name: chrome-bg
tokens.usage: Title bar and sidebar. VS Code workbench background.

tokens.name: pane-bg
tokens.usage: Chat column and the bottom panel (Output, Terminal).

tokens.name: aux-bg

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Composer field, menus, palettes, tooltips. Always paired with border and, for floating layers, shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on rows, ghost buttons, tabs.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row in a list or tree, active segment.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Inline code chips and command chips inside chat text.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Pane dividers and section rules. Hairline, 1px.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control outlines: composer, inputs, secondary buttons, menus.

tokens.name: fg-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, selected row text, user message text.

tokens.name: fg

tokens.name: fg-muted

tokens.name: activity-fg-muted

tokens.name: fg-subtle

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The only brand hue. Primary button fill, focus ring, active tab underline, selection in inputs.

tokens.name: focus-border
tokens.usage: Focus outline on rows and buttons, and the composer container border while it has focus. Same value as VS Code focusBorder, #007acc (accent stays #0078d4).

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and file references in chat, on surface-raised.

tokens.name: provider-claude
tokens.usage: Claude mark only (session rows, chat header, composer model button). Provider marks are the one place a hue other than accent may appear, so the three providers tell apart at 14px; never use it for text or state.

tokens.name: provider-codex
tokens.usage: Codex mark only. OpenAI's mark is monochrome, so it takes the strongest text color against the orange and violet of the other two.

tokens.name: provider-antigravity
tokens.usage: Antigravity mark only. Violet stays clear of running blue, warning yellow, danger red and success green.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Session running dot and progress. Same family as accent so 'busy' never reads as an error.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done state, added line count (+12).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Permission requests waiting, Bypass Permissions label.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, removed line count (-4), destructive actions.

tokens.usage: Changed-word highlight inside an added line. VS Code diffEditor.insertedTextBackground.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Removed line background in diffs, also the gutter strip. VS Code diffEditor.removedLineBackground.

tokens.name: diff-del-gutter
tokens.usage: Changed-word highlight inside a removed line. VS Code diffEditor.removedTextBackground.
